cohort: 96 parturients with meconium-stained liquor at a tertiary healthcare facility in West Bengal, India
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) is associated with poor perinatal outcomes, including lower Apgar scores, increased SNCU admission, and higher neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Thick meconium was associated with higher rates of instrumental vaginal delivery and cesarean section compared to thin meconium.
birth_weight: 68.8% of newborns had a birth weight of 2.5-3.5 kg
